text:
Ellen (People Ops): Quick pulse — auditors requested a short-notice snapshot. New upload hard deadline: Thu 05/05 15:00 PT. This is a single intake (no rolling uploads). Please follow the exact filename rules below so our ingestion picks things up.

Ravi (Security): Which control families are the priority this round? Want to surface them early.

Ellen (People Ops): Auditors flagged: access reviews, vendor assessments that touch customer data, key management logs, and incident tabletop minutes. Focus on those first and mark them in the uploader as HIGH.

Sofia (Eng): For access reviews, do we need screenshots or will CSV exports with query and export time work?

Ravi (Security): CSV exports are preferred. Include the one-line query used, export timestamp, and a 1-line README. Filenames must follow the pattern below for automation.

Ellen (People Ops): Filename pattern (must match exactly):
20260505_<team>_<control>.<ext>
Examples: 20260505_eng_access.csv, 20260505_legal_vendor_packet.pdf, 20260505_infra_kms.csv
Also complete the uploader fields: control id, owner email, production=true/false, provisional=true/false. Uploader: https://go.redwood.company/evidence-intake

Noah (Procurement): Procurement backlog — if a vendor questionnaire is pending, will a signed PO + procurement status email count as provisional evidence?

Ravi (Security): Yes — PO + procurement email with expected completion is acceptable provisional evidence. Mark it provisional and follow up with final docs within 7 business days.

Sofia (Eng): Dashboards show relative timestamps (e.g., "5 minutes ago"). Do auditors require absolute timestamps?

Ravi (Security): Absolute timestamps required. If the UI lacks them, include an exported query or log with the run time in the README. Screenshots without absolutes will be rejected.

compliance_bot: Reminder created — "Snapshot evidence due Thu 05/05 15:00 PT". It will post in #people-ops and DM listed owners on due day at 09:00 PT.

Ellen (People Ops): Office hours this week: Tue 10:00-11:30 PT, Wed 14:00-16:00 PT. Link in the compliance page. We also have 20-min 1:1 slots Thu morning — sign up if you need hand-holding.

Sofia (Eng): Small Q: infra asks to include KMS rotation history. Is a 30-day export okay?

Ravi (Security): 30-day export is fine. Redact any secret values and include a one-line redaction note in README. Filename example: 20260505_infra_kms.csv

Noah (Procurement): I'll push provisional vendor packets and tag owners.

Ellen (People Ops): Important automation notes: 1) exact filename pattern is validated automatically, mismatches are auto-rejected; 2) zips must be flat (no nested directories); 3) if redacting, add a clear single-line note listing redacted fields; 4) contractor/vendor portal artifacts require a sponsor attestation email uploaded alongside the artifact.

Sofia (Eng): Got it — engineering will assemble a flat zip with README at root and upload Wed EOD.

Ellen (People Ops): If you miss the cutoff we will accept late uploads but they will be processed as exceptions and add review time. Please escalate blockers in #compliance-help or DM me. Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn on this. :pray:
